title: Rome, Florence and Paris Honeymoon
alt: The dome of Florence Cathedral above the Tuscan rooftops
transport: Rail between cities, private transfers and guided sightseeing

stops.name: Rome
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel within reach of the centro storico

activities.name: Rome hop on hop off bus tour
activities.description: A 24 hour open top ticket looping the Colosseum, the Forum and Piazza Venezia, so you hop off wherever you please.

activities.name: Vatican Museums
activities.description: The papal collections and the long gallery of maps, ending in the Sistine Chapel under Michelangelo's ceiling.

program.name: Rome
program.description: Two nights in the Eternal City, with an open top bus loop and a morning in the Vatican Museums.

stops.name: Florence
stops.subtitle: Florence → Pisa and Tuscany
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Central hotel within walking distance of the Duomo

activities.name: Florence hop on hop off bus tour
activities.description: An open top loop of the Renaissance city, past the Duomo, the Ponte Vecchio and up to the Piazzale Michelangelo.

activities.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa guided tour
activities.description: A guided day across the Tuscan countryside to the Campo dei Miracoli, the leaning campanile and the Romanesque cathedral.

program.name: Florence
program.description: Two nights in Tuscany, with an open top loop of the Renaissance city and a day out at the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

stops.name: Paris
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Well placed hotel on the Metro within reach of the Eiffel Tower

activities.name: Eiffel Tower and a Seine river cruise
activities.description: Up the tower for the city from the air, then an hour on the Seine past the Louvre, the Musee d'Orsay and Notre Dame.

activities.name: Disneyland Paris
activities.description: A full day at Disneyland Paris, forty minutes east of the city, with both the castle park and the studios to choose from.

program.name: Paris
program.description: Two nights to finish, with the Eiffel Tower, a cruise on the Seine and a full day at Disneyland.

day_titles.5: To Paris, the Eiffel Tower and the Seine

1: Arrival at Fiumicino and transfer to your hotel
Check in and freshen up before heading out
A 24 hour open top bus ticket for the city
The Colosseum, the Forum and Piazza Venezia
2: Breakfast, then across the river to the Vatican
The papal collections and the long gallery of maps
The Sistine Chapel under Michelangelo's ceiling
The evening free for dinner in Trastevere
3: Breakfast and check out of your Rome hotel
Station transfer and the fast train north to Florence
Check in within walking distance of the Duomo
An open top loop up to the Piazzale Michelangelo
4: Breakfast, then west across the Tuscan countryside
Vineyards and cypress ridges on the way to Pisa
The leaning campanile on the Campo dei Miracoli
The Romanesque cathedral before the run back
5: Breakfast and check out for the journey to France
Station transfer and the train on to Paris
Check in, then out to the Eiffel Tower
An hour on the Seine past Notre Dame
6: Breakfast, then east to Disneyland Paris
A full day in the castle park and the studios
Shops and restaurants along Disney Village
Back at the hotel in the evening
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Charles de Gaulle for your flight home

expert.name: Sharon
expert.quote: Rome, Florence and Paris in six nights, with Pisa and Disneyland folded in. It is the classic first honeymoon in Europe.
expert.tip: Book the Vatican for a Tuesday or Thursday morning. Mondays and weekends are the worst and the Sistine Chapel becomes shoulder to shoulder.

summary: Seven days across Italy and France: two nights in Rome with an open top bus and the Vatican Museums, two in Florence with a day out at the Leaning Tower of Pisa, then Paris for the Eiffel Tower, a Seine cruise and Disneyland.
included: Included: 2 nights in Rome, 2 nights in Florence and 2 nights in Paris with breakfast; private airport transfers; rail between the cities; a 24 hour Rome hop on hop off bus ticket; Vatican Museums entry; a Florence hop on hop off bus ticket; a guided Leaning Tower of Pisa day trip; the Eiffel Tower with a Seine river cruise; a full day at Disneyland Paris.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses. Hotels on this itinerary are named on confirmation: the operator quotes a three star standard rather than fixed properties.
